posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
I bought a newer laptop that runs Windows 11 Home edition. I got MV working on it, but there is a bit of a glitch with the editor. On my old (Windows 10) laptop, there is a drop-down menu, with headings such as "File", "Edit" "Mode" and so on. Just underneath, there is a row of icons to do things like start a new project, open a project, save project, and all the others up to playtest.
On my new(er) Windows 11 laptop, the icons are superimposed on the menu. The icons don't work, but the menu (once I find the right heading for what I want to do) does. To summarise, MV works, but is a bit of a pain. Does anyone know of a way to either make the icons functional and display the menu, or to suppress the icons so that the menu is easily visible?
Gospodin Google didn't seem to find anything relevant whe I searched for "rpg maker mv on windows 11".
My intention is to have MV on just the new laptop, and probably use it to try MZ. I want to keep the old (Windows 10) laptop for VX Ace and VX, and any programs and games that I can't get to work on the new laptop, sabotaging Internet access when Microsoft drop support for Windows 10.
Anybody got any ideas or suggestions? Thank you in anticipation.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
I think it is part of the scaling functions of Windows that went wrong.
There always has been an option in newer Windows versions to automatically upsize fonts and/or icons of programs to make them better readable on larger screens, and in Windows 10/11 it seems to be that it is automatically activated on a higher scale.
I don't know where that is in Win 11, but try to find it and reset it to 100%, that should help.

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
@gundambison
Thank you for your advice. I tried making a new user profile and running MV whilst in it, but still had the same problem.
I might consider having a new operating system installed. I live in Bulgaria, but am English. I would prefer a UK English new installation as I don't like having to deal with messages in Bulgarian about cookies, or security verification.
One thing that I didn't mention is that the display resolution is the recommended 1920 x 1080. I did try one of the smaller resolutions, but it didn't make a difference.
Edit
:
I have a nasty feeling that this issue won't be solved quickly. In case someone else has a similar problem, here are a few more details. All the dialogs in the editor come out a bit weird looking. Any icons etc. have to be selected or clicked lower than the icon appears on the screen.
The problem only affects the editor. When playtesting a game in the editor, or playing a deployed game, everything is fine.
This just seems to be a problem with RPG Maker. I downloaded the MZ trial and had a quick play, with similar results. Other programs such as Libre Office and Anyrail are fine.
I tried re-installing MV, with no improvement. The fact that
@gundambison
doesn't get this problem on his Windows 11 machine is interesting. There doesn't seem to be anyone else reporting a similar problem despite the fact that there must be a reasonable number of Windows 11 users on this forum.
I tried making a new project in case it was something to do with the existing projects, but it was the same.
MV is difficult to use on my new computer, but MZ seems slightly easier because of the way the editor is designed. Until a solution appears, I will finish my current project on my old laptop. I will experiment with MZ, but might not buy it after the trial ends.
